Claude Code asks once whether to use the project MCP server "locklog"; approve it.
The calls below never touch data without the console's approval; they are in
"permissions.allow" in .claude/settings.local.json (personal: check that git
ignores it), so Claude Code does not prompt for them. Remove them there to be
asked again:

  "mcp__locklog__locklog_status",
  "mcp__locklog__locklog_sources",
  "mcp__locklog__locklog_search",
  "mcp__locklog__locklog_count",
  "mcp__locklog__locklog_pii_list",
  "mcp__locklog__locklog_pii_add"

The free locklog tools answer masked data within the budgets; anything beyond them (a policy change, a scan, an unmask) is approved in the locklog console.
